title: 산업기술의 유출방지 및 보호에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy ( Technology Security Division ), 044-203-4854

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「산업기술의 유출방지 및 보호에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Prevention and Protection of Industrial Technology Leakage and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제1조의2(기술안보센터 지정신청서) 「산업기술의 유출방지 및 보호에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제9조의2제3항에 따른 기술안보센터 지정신청서는 별지 제1호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 (Application for Designation of Technology Security Center) The application for designation of a Technology Security Center pursuant to Article 9-2, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Prevention and Protection of Industrial Technology Leakage (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 attached hereto .

[This Article was newly added on July 18, 2025.]
[Formerly Article 1-2 was moved to Article 1-3 <July 18, 2025>]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의3(국가핵심기술 여부 판정신청서) 영 제13조의2제1항에 따른 국가핵심기술 여부 판정신청서는 별지 제1호의2서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-3 (Application for Determination of National Core Technology) The application for determination of national core technology pursuant to Article 13-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1-2 of the Attached Form .

[Wholly Amended Jul. 18, 2025]
[Moved from Article 1-2 <July 18, 2025>]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의4(국가핵심기술 보유기관 등록신청서) 영 제13조의3제1항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 국가핵심기술 보유기관 등록신청서는 별지 제1호의3서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-4 (Application for Registration of National Core Technology Holding Institution) The application for registration of a national core technology holding institution pursuant to the part other than each subparagraph of Article 13-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1-3 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted July 18, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의5(국가핵심기술 보유기관 등록증) 영 제13조의3제3항에 따른 국가핵심기술 보유기관 등록증은 별지 제1호의4서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-5 (Certificate of Registration of Institutions Possessing National Core Technology) The Certificate of Registration of Institutions Possessing National Core Technology pursuant to Article 13-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1-4 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted July 18, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의6(국가핵심기술 보유기관 등록대장) 영 제13조의3제3항에 따른 국가핵심기술 보유기관 등록대장은 별지 제1호의5서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-6 (Register of Institutions Holding National Core Technologies) The register of institutions holding national core technologies pursuant to Article 13-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1-5 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted July 18, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의7(국가핵심기술 보유기관 변경등록신청서) 영 제13조의3제4항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 국가핵심기술 보유기관 변경등록신청서는 별지 제1호의6서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-7 (Application for Change of Registration of National Core Technology Holding Institution) The application for change of registration of a national core technology holding institution pursuant to the part other than each subparagraph of Article 13-3, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1-6 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted July 18, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의8(국가핵심기술 보유기관 등록말소신청서) 영 제13조의4제1항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 국가핵심기술 보유기관 등록말소신청서는 별지 제1호의7서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-8 (Application for Deletion of Registration of National Core Technology Holding Institution) The application for deletion of registration of a national core technology holding institution pursuant to the part other than each subparagraph of Article 13-4, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1-7 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted July 18, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(국가핵심기술 수출승인신청서) 영 제15조제1항에 따른 국가핵심기술 수출승인신청서는 별지 제2호서식에 따른다. <개정 2012. 1. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Application for Export Approval of National Core Technologies) The application for export approval of national core technologies pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 2 of the Attached Form . <Amended Jan. 25, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(국가핵심기술 수출신고서) 영 제16조제1항에 따른 국가핵심기술 수출신고서는 별지 제3호서식에 따른다. <개정 2012. 1. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Export Declaration of National Core Technology) The export declaration of national core technology pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Form . <Amended Jan. 25, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(국가핵심기술 사전검토신청서) 영 제17조제1항에 따른 국가핵심기술 사전검토신청서는 별지 제4호서식에 따른다. <개정 2012. 1. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Preliminary Review of National Core Technologies) The application for preliminary review of national core technologies pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form. <Amended Jan. 25, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제4조의2(해외인수ㆍ합병등 승인신청서) 영 제18조의4제1항에 따른 국가핵심기술 해외인수ㆍ합병등 승인신청서는 별지 제5호서식과 같다. <개정 2025. 7. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 4-2 (Application for Approval of Overseas Acquisition, Merger, etc.) The application for approval of overseas acquisition, merger, etc. of national core technologies pursuant to Article 18-4(1) of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 5. <Amended July 18, 2025>

[This Article was newly added on Feb. 21, 2020.]
[Formerly Article 4-2 was moved to Article 4-3 <February 21, 2020>]

rows.source_ko: 제4조의3(해외인수ㆍ합병등 신고서) 영 제18조의5제1항 또는 제18조의6제1항ㆍ제2항에 따른 국가핵심기술 해외인수ㆍ합병등 신고서는 별지 제5호의2서식과 같다. <개정 2025. 7. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 4-3 (Report on Overseas Acquisition, Merger, etc.) The report on overseas acquisition, merger, etc. of national core technologies pursuant to Article 18-5, Paragraph 1 or Article 18-6, Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 5-2 of the Attached Subparagraph . <Amended July 18, 2025>

[Wholly Amended Feb. 21, 2020]
[Moved from Article 4-2; former Article 4-3 moved to Article 4-4 <February 21, 2020>]

rows.source_ko: 제4조의4(해외인수ㆍ합병등 사전검토신청서) 영 제18조의8제1항에 따른 국가핵심기술 해외인수ㆍ합병등 사전검토신청서는 별지 제6호서식과 같다. <개정 2025. 7. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 4-4 (Application for Prior Review of Overseas Acquisition, Merger, etc.) The application for prior review of overseas acquisition, merger, etc. involving national core technologies pursuant to Article 18-8, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be as in Annex 6. <Amended July 18, 2025>

[Wholly Amended Feb. 21, 2020]
[Moved from Article 4-3; former Article 4-4 moved to Article 4-5 <February 21, 2020>]

rows.source_ko: 제4조의5(산업기술 확인신청) ① 영 제19조의3제1항에 따라 보유하고 있는 기술이 산업기술에 해당하는지에 대한 확인을 신청하려는 대상기관은 별지 제6호의2서식의 산업기술 확인 신청서를 법 제16조제1항에 따른 산업기술보호협회에 제출해야 한다. <개정 2020. 2. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 4-5 (Application for Confirmation of Industrial Technology) ①Any institution subject to applying for confirmation as to whether technology it possesses constitutes industrial technology pursuant to Article 19-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit the Application for Confirmation of Industrial Technology in the form of Annex 6-2 to the Industrial Technology Protection Association pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the Act . <Amended Feb. 21, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제19조의3제1항제1호에 따른 신청기술 설명서는 별지 제6호의3서식과 같다. <개정 2020. 2. 21.>
rows.text_en: ② The description of the applied technology pursuant to Article 19-3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 6-3 of the Attached Form . <Amended Feb. 21, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제19조의3제3항에 따른 산업기술 확인서는 별지 제6호의4서식과 같다. <개정 2020. 2. 21.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Certificate of Industrial Technology pursuant to Article 19-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 6-4 . <Amended Feb. 21, 2020>

[This Article newly inserted on Apr. 28, 2015]
[Moved from Article 4-4 on Feb. 21, 2020>]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(산업기술침해신고서) 영 제20조제1항에 따른 산업기술침해신고서는 별지 제7호서식에 따른다. <개정 2012. 1. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Report of Industrial Technology Infringement) The report of industrial technology infringement pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 7 of the Attached Form . <Amended Jan. 25, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(포상금의 지급기준 등) ①영 제26조제2항에 따른 포상금의 지급기준은 별표와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Standards for Payment of Rewards, etc.) ①The standards for payment of rewards pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree are as set forth in the attached table .

rows.source_ko: ②하나의 사건에 대하여 신고한 자가 2명 이상이면 신고의 선후(先後) 및 구체성, 신고로 인한 공로 등을 고려하여 제1항에 따라 산정한 포상금을 적절하게 배분하여 지급한다. 다만, 포상금을 지급받을 자가 배분 방법에 관하여 미리 합의하여 포상금의 지급을 신청하는 경우에는 그 합의된 방법에 따라 지급한다.
rows.text_en: ② If there are two or more persons who have reported a single incident, the reward calculated according to Paragraph 1 shall be appropriately distributed and paid, taking into consideration the order and specificity of the reports, and the merits resulting from the reports. However, if the persons entitled to receive the reward apply for payment after agreeing in advance on the method of distribution, the reward shall be paid according to the agreed method.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(신변보호등요청서) 영 제27조에 따른 신변보호등요청서는 별지 제8호서식에 따른다. <개정 2012. 1. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Request for Personal Protection, etc.) The request for personal protection, etc. pursuant to Article 27 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 8 of the Attached Form . <Amended Jan. 25, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(조정신청서) 「산업기술의 유출방지 및 보호에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제26조제1항에 따른 조정신청서는 별지 제9호서식에 따른다. <개정 2012. 1. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Application for Mediation) The application for mediation pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Prevention and Protection of Industrial Technology Leakage (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 9 of the Attached Form . <Amended Jan. 25, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(수수료) 법 제32조제2항에 따른 수수료는 1만원으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Fees) The fees pursuant to Article 32, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be 10,000 won.

rows.source_ko: 제10조(과태료의 징수절차) 영 제37조제4항에 따른 과태료의 징수절차에 관하여는 「국고금관리법 시행규칙」을 준용한다. 이 경우 납입고지서에는 이의방법 및 이의기간 등을 함께 적어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Procedures for Collection of Administrative Fines) The Enforcement Rules of the National Treasury Management Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the procedures for collection of administrative fines pursuant to Article 37, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree. In this case, the notice of payment must also state the method of objection and the period for objection, etc.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy Decree No. 396, Apr. 27, 2007>
This rule shall take effect on April 28, 2007.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <지식경제부령 제1호, 2008. 3. 3.> (지식경제부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Knowledge Economy Decree No. 1, Mar. 3, 2008> (Enforcement Rule of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Knowledge Economy and Its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Articles 2  through 4 omitted

rows.text_en: Article 5 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through ⑯ Omitted

rows.source_ko: ⑰ 산업기술의 유출방지 및 보호에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: 17. The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Prevention and Protection of Industrial Technology Leakage are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제1호서식 앞쪽, 별지 제2호서식, 별지 제3호서식 앞쪽, 별지 제4호서식, 별지 제6호서식 앞쪽 중 “산업자원부장관”을 각각 “지식경제부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the front of Form No. 1, Form No. 2, Form No. 3, Form No. 4, and Form No. 6, “Minister of Commerce, Industry and Energy” shall be changed to “Minister of Knowledge Economy”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제1호서식 뒤쪽, 별지 제3호서식 뒤쪽, 별지 제6호서식 뒤쪽 중 “산업자원부”를 각각 “지식경제부”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the back of Form No. 1, Form No. 3, and Form No. 6, “Ministry of Commerce and Industry” shall be changed to “Ministry of Knowledge Economy”.
Sections 18 through <64> omitted
ADDENDA <Ministry of Knowledge Economy Decree No. 239, Jan. 25, 2012>
This rule shall take effect on January 26, 2012.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <산업통상자원부령 제1호, 2013. 3. 23.> (산업통상자원부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy Decree No. 1, Mar. 23, 2013> (Enforcement Rule of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. <단서 생략>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso Omitted>
Articles 2  through 6 omitted

rows.source_ko: 제7조(다른 법령의 개정) ①부터 ⑱까지 생략
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through ⑱ Omitted

rows.source_ko: ⑲ 산업기술의 유출방지 및 보호에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: 19. The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Prevention and Protection of Industrial Technology Leakage are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제1호서식 앞쪽, 별지 제2호서식 앞쪽, 별지 제3호서식 앞쪽, 별지 제4호서식 앞쪽, 별지 제5호서식 앞쪽, 별지 제6호서식 앞쪽, 별지 제7호서식 및 별지 제9호서식 중 “지식경제부장관”을 각각 “산업통상자원부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the front of Form No. 1, the front of Form No. 2, the front of Form No. 3, the front of Form No. 4, the front of Form No. 5, the front of Form No. 6, Form No. 7, and Form No. 9, “Minister of Knowledge Economy” shall be changed to “Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제1호서식 뒤쪽, 별지 제2호서식 뒤쪽, 별지 제3호서식 뒤쪽, 별지 제4호서식 뒤쪽, 별지 제5호서식 뒤쪽, 별지 제6호서식 뒤쪽, 별지 제7호서식 및 별지 제9호서식 중 “지식경제부”를 각각 “산업통상자원부”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the back of Form No. 1, the back of Form No. 2, the back of Form No. 3, the back of Form No. 4, the back of Form No. 5, the back of Form No. 6, Form No. 7, and Form No. 9, “Ministry of Knowledge Economy” shall be changed to “Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy”.
Sections 20 through <63> omitted

This rule shall take effect on April 29, 2015.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <산업통상자원부령 제448호, 2022. 1. 21.> (고압가스 안전관리법 시행규칙 등 36개 산업통상자원부령 일부개정령)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy Decree No. 448, Jan. 21, 2022> (Partial Amendment to 36 Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy Decrees, including the Enforcement Rule of the High-Pressure Gas Safety Management Act)
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

This rule shall take effect on July 29, 2024.

This rule shall take effect on July 22, 2025.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <산업통상부령 제1호, 2025. 10. 1.> (산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy Decree No. 1, Oct. 1, 2025> (Enforcement Rule of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 부칙 제5조에 따라 개정되는 부령 중 이 규칙 시행 전에 공포되었으나 시행일이 도래하지 않은 부령을 개정한 부분은 해당 부령의 시행일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, among the Ministerial Ordinances amended pursuant to Article 5 of the Addenda, the parts amending Ministerial Ordinances that were promulgated prior to the enforcement of this Rule but whose effective date has not yet arrived shall enter into force on the effective date of said Ministerial Ordinance.
Articles 2  through 4 omitted
